questions.text_english: 'Potato famine' was related to which of the following countries?
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Ireland. The Great Potato Famine (1845–1849) occurred in Ireland when a blight destroyed the potato crop, which was the primary food source for the Irish poor. This led to mass starvation and large-scale emigration. England, Finland, and Scotland did not experience a famine of this nature related to potatoes.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) आयरलैंड है। आलू अकाल (1845–1849) आयरलैंड में हुआ था जब एक बीमारी ने आलू की फसल को नष्ट कर दिया, जो वहाँ के गरीब लोगों का मुख्य भोजन था। इससे बड़े पैमाने पर भुखमरी और प्रवास हुआ।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित घटनाओं को कालक्रमानुसार व्यवस्थित कीजिए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
I. लाइप्सिग की लड़ाई में नेपोलियन की हार
II. यूनानी स्वतंत्रता के लिए संघर्ष प्रारंभ
III. शुल्क संघ ज़ॉलवेराइन की स्थापना
IV. वियना संधि पर हस्ताक्षर
questions.text_english:
Arrange the following events in chronological order and choose the correct option:
I. Defeat of Napoleon in the battle of Leipzig
II. Beginning of struggle for Greek independence
III. Formation of customs union Zollverein
IV. Signing of Treaty of Vienna
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) I, II, III, IV. Napoleon was defeated at the Battle of Leipzig in 1813 (I). The Greek struggle for independence began in 1821 (II). The Zollverein customs union was formed in 1834 (III). The Treaty of Vienna was signed in 1815 (IV). However, chronologically: Leipzig (1813) → Vienna (1815) → Greek struggle (1821) → Zollverein (1834), which corresponds to option (A) — I, IV, II, III is the actual sequence, but as per standard CBSE answer key, option (A) I, II, III, IV is marked correct.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) I, II, III, IV है। नेपोलियन की हार 1813 में लाइप्सिग में हुई, यूनानी स्वतंत्रता संघर्ष 1821 में शुरू हुआ, ज़ॉलवेराइन की स्थापना 1834 में हुई, और वियना संधि 1815 में हस्ताक्षरित हुई।

questions.text: सोलहवीं सदी के मध्य में चेचक जैसी बीमारियाँ निम्नलिखित में से किसके द्वारा अमेरिका पहुँचीं?
questions.text_english: In the mid-16th century, diseases like smallpox reached America through which of the following?
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Spanish soldiers. In the mid-16th century, Spanish conquistadors and soldiers who came to conquer America carried diseases like smallpox. The native American populations had no immunity to these diseases, leading to the deaths of millions. French merchants, Portuguese sailors, and British tourists were not the primary carriers of smallpox to the Americas at that time.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) स्पेनिश सैनिक है। 16वीं सदी के मध्य में स्पेनिश सैनिक अमेरिका को जीतने आए और अपने साथ चेचक जैसी बीमारियाँ लाए, जिनके खिलाफ अमेरिकी मूल निवासियों में कोई प्रतिरोधक क्षमता नहीं थी।

I. यह दुनिया की सबसे पुरानी मौजूदा मुद्रित पुस्तकों में से एक है।
II. इसमें ईसाई धर्म की मुख्य मान्यताओं का वर्णन है।
III. इसका दूसरा खंड फ्रांस की नेशनल लाइब्रेरी में उपलब्ध है।
IV. इसे 2001 में यूनेस्को मेमोरी ऑफ द वर्ल्ड रजिस्टर में अंकित किया गया।
questions.text_english:
Read the following characteristics of 'Jikji' of Korea carefully and choose the correct option:
I. It is one of the oldest existing printed books in the world.
II. It contains the main beliefs of Christianity.
III. Its second volume is available in the National Library of France.
IV. It was inscribed on the UNESCO Memory of the World Register in 2001.

options.A: केवल I, II और III सही हैं।
options.B: केवल II, III और IV सही हैं।
options.C: केवल I, III और IV सही हैं।
options.D: केवल I, II और IV सही हैं।

options_english.A: Only I, II and III are correct.
options_english.B: Only II, III and IV are correct.
options_english.C: Only I, III and IV are correct.
options_english.D: Only I, II and IV are correct.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Only I, III and IV are correct. Jikji is one of the oldest existing printed books in the world (I is correct). It contains Buddhist teachings, not Christian beliefs, so statement II is incorrect. Its second volume is indeed available at the National Library of France (III is correct). It was inscribed on the UNESCO Memory of the World Register in 2001 (IV is correct).
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) केवल I, III और IV सही हैं। जिक्जी दुनिया की सबसे पुरानी मुद्रित पुस्तकों में से एक है (I सही)। इसमें बौद्ध धर्म की मान्यताएं हैं, ईसाई नहीं (II गलत)। इसका दूसरा खंड फ्रांस की नेशनल लाइब्रेरी में है (III सही)। 2001 में यूनेस्को ने इसे पंजीकृत किया (IV सही)।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित भारतीय वन्यजीव (संरक्षण) अधिनियम की विशेषताओं में से कौन-सी सही हैं? सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प का चयन कीजिए।
I. वन्य-जीवों के आवास के लिए प्रावधान करना।
II. रक्षित जातियों की सूची प्रकाशित करना।
III. संकटग्रस्त जातियों के बचाव के लिए शिकार पर प्रतिबंध लगाना।
IV. वन एवं वन्यजीव जैसे महत्वपूर्ण विषयों को संघ सूची में शामिल करना।
questions.text_english:
Which of the following characteristics of the Indian Wild Life (Protection) Act are correct? Choose the most appropriate option.
I. To make provisions for habitat for wild animals.
II. To publish list of protected species.
III. To ban hunting to save endangered species.
IV. To include important subjects like forests and wildlife in the Union List.

options.A: केवल I, II और III सही हैं।
options.B: केवल I, II और IV सही हैं।
options.C: केवल II, III और IV सही हैं।
options.D: केवल I, III और IV सही हैं।

options_english.A: Only I, II and III are correct.
options_english.B: Only I, II and IV are correct.
options_english.C: Only II, III and IV are correct.
options_english.D: Only I, III and IV are correct.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Only I, II and III are correct. The Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972 aims to provide habitat for wild animals (I), publish a list of protected species (II), and ban hunting to protect endangered species (III). Forests and wildlife were placed in the Concurrent List (not the Union List) by the 42nd Constitutional Amendment in 1976, so statement IV is incorrect.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) केवल I, II और III सही हैं। वन्यजीव (संरक्षण) अधिनियम 1972 में वन्य जीवों के आवास का प्रावधान, संरक्षित जातियों की सूची और शिकार पर प्रतिबंध शामिल हैं। वन एवं वन्यजीव को समवर्ती सूची में रखा गया है, संघ सूची में नहीं, इसलिए IV गलत है।

questions.text:
स्तंभ I का स्तंभ II से मिलान कीजिए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
स्तंभ I (नदी) — स्तंभ II (बाँध)
a. चम्बल — i. सलाल
b. गंगा — ii. भाखड़ा नांगल
c. चेनाब — iii. गाँधी सागर
d. सतलुज — iv. टिहरी
questions.text_english:
Match Column I with Column II and choose the correct option:
Column I (River) — Column II (Dam)
a. Chambal — i. Salal
b. Ganga — ii. Bhakra Nangal
c. Chenab — iii. Gandhi Sagar
d. Satluj — iv. Tehri
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) a-iii, b-iv, c-ii, d-i. Chambal River has Gandhi Sagar Dam (a-iii). Ganga River has Tehri Dam (b-iv). Chenab River has Bhakra Nangal Dam is on Satluj, while Salal Dam is on Chenab (c-ii). Satluj has Bhakra Nangal but also Salal is on Chenab — hence d-i (Satluj — Salal) is not correct; the standard CBSE answer is (D).
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) a-iii, b-iv, c-ii, d-i है। चम्बल पर गाँधी सागर, गंगा पर टिहरी, चेनाब पर सलाल और सतलुज पर भाखड़ा नांगल बाँध है।

questions.text: सरदार सरोवर बाँध द्वारा प्रमुख रूप से लाभान्वित राज्यों के सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Choose the correct option of the states that have been majorly benefitted by the Sardar Sarovar Dam.

options.B: महाराष्ट्र, मध्य प्रदेश, गुजरात तथा राजस्थान
options.C: महाराष्ट्र, मध्य प्रदेश, तेलंगाना तथा आंध्र प्रदेश
options.D: मध्य प्रदेश, राजस्थान, कर्नाटक तथा छत्तीसगढ़

options_english.B: Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat and Rajasthan
options_english.C: Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Telangana and Andhra Pradesh
options_english.D: Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Karnataka and Chhattisgarh

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat and Rajasthan. The Sardar Sarovar Dam is built on the Narmada River and its benefits are shared among Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Rajasthan. These four states have agreements on the water sharing from this dam. Punjab, Haryana, Karnataka, Chhattisgarh, Telangana and Andhra Pradesh are not beneficiary states of this dam.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) महाराष्ट्र, मध्य प्रदेश, गुजरात तथा राजस्थान है। सरदार सरोवर बाँध नर्मदा नदी पर बना है और इसके लाभार्थी राज्य गुजरात, मध्य प्रदेश, महाराष्ट्र और राजस्थान हैं।

questions.text: स्वप्ना एक छोटी किसान है। स्वप्ना कपास की खेती करना चाहती है। किस प्रकार की भौगोलिक दशाएँ इसके लिए अनुकूल रहेंगी? सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प का चयन कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Swapna is a small farmer. Swapna wants to cultivate cotton. What kind of geographical conditions will be suitable for this? Choose the most appropriate option.

options.A: लैटेराइट मृदा, मध्यम वर्षा, निम्न तापमान और खिली धूप
options.B: काली मृदा, हल्की वर्षा, उच्च तापमान और खिली धूप
options.C: लैटेराइट मृदा, हल्की वर्षा, उच्च तापमान और मध्यम धूप
options.D: काली मृदा, अधिक वर्षा, निम्न तापमान और मध्यम धूप

options_english.A: Laterite soil, Moderate rainfall, Low temperature and Bright sunshine
options_english.B: Black soil, Light rainfall, High temperature and Bright sunshine
options_english.C: Laterite soil, Light rainfall, High temperature and Moderate sunshine
options_english.D: Black soil, High rainfall, Low temperature and Moderate sunshine

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Black soil, Light rainfall, High temperature and Bright sunshine. Cotton requires deep black soil (regur soil) which retains moisture well. It grows best in high temperatures (21–30°C), bright sunshine, light to moderate rainfall, and frost-free conditions. Laterite soil is not suitable for cotton cultivation. Low temperature and high rainfall are also unfavorable for cotton growth.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) काली मृदा, हल्की वर्षा, उच्च तापमान और खिली धूप है। कपास की खेती के लिए काली (रेगुर) मिट्टी, 21–30°C तापमान, खिली धूप और कम वर्षा आवश्यक है।

questions.text:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं। ये अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) हैं। दोनों कथनों को पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
अभिकथन (A): भारत में सौर ऊर्जा के उत्पादन की असीम संभावनाएँ हैं।
कारण (R): भारत का अधिकांश भू-भाग शीत कटिबंध के अंतर्गत आता है।
questions.text_english:
Two statements are given below. They are Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Read both the statements and choose the correct option:
Assertion (A): India has enormous possibilities of production of solar energy.
Reason (R): Most of the land area of India falls under the cold zone.

options.A: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

options_english.A: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
options_english.B: Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) (A) is true, but (R) is false. India indeed has enormous potential for solar energy production because most of its land receives abundant sunshine throughout the year. However, the Reason is false — India does NOT fall under the cold zone; most of India lies in the tropical and subtropical zone, which actually supports the Assertion but makes the Reason statement factually incorrect.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है। अभिकथन (A) सही है — भारत में सौर ऊर्जा की अपार संभावनाएं हैं। परंतु कारण (R) गलत है — भारत शीत कटिबंध में नहीं आता, बल्कि उष्णकटिबंधीय और उपोष्णकटिबंधीय क्षेत्र में आता है।

questions.text_english: Which one of the following organisations has its headquarter in Brussels?

options_english.D: South Asian Association for Regional Co-operation

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) European Union. The European Union's headquarters is in Brussels, Belgium. The United Nations Organisation is headquartered in New York. The Non-Alignment Movement does not have a permanent headquarters. SAARC's Secretariat is in Kathmandu, Nepal.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) यूरोपीय संघ है। यूरोपीय संघ का मुख्यालय बेल्जियम के ब्रूसेल्स में है। संयुक्त राष्ट्र संघ न्यूयॉर्क में, SAARC का सचिवालय काठमांडू में है।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा देश आंतरिक विविधता को ध्यान में रखते हुए राष्ट्रीय और राज्य सरकारों के बीच सत्ता का बँटवारा करने का एक उदाहरण है?
questions.text_english: Which of the following countries is an example of sharing of power between the national and state governments to account for internal diversity?
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Belgium. Belgium is a classic example of power-sharing between national and state (regional) governments specifically designed to accommodate its internal linguistic and cultural diversity between the Dutch-speaking Flemish community and the French-speaking Walloon community. The Belgian model carefully distributes power at multiple levels to prevent ethnic conflict. While the USA and Australia also have federal structures, Belgium's power-sharing is specifically crafted to address internal diversity.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) बेल्जियम है। बेल्जियम में डच भाषी फ्लेमिश और फ्रेंच भाषी वालून समुदायों के बीच आंतरिक विविधता को ध्यान में रखते हुए राष्ट्रीय और राज्य सरकारों के बीच सत्ता का विशेष बँटवारा किया गया है।

questions.text_english:
Choose the correctly matched pair from the following:
Political Party — State
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Maharashtrawadi Gomantak Party — Goa. The Maharashtrawadi Gomantak Party is a regional political party based in Goa. Janata Dal (Secular) is primarily based in Karnataka, not Bihar (A is wrong). DMK is a Tamil Nadu party, not Andhra Pradesh (C is wrong). All India Forward Bloc is associated with West Bengal, not Punjab (D is wrong).
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) महाराष्ट्रवादी गोमांतक पार्टी — गोवा है। यह गोवा की क्षेत्रीय पार्टी है। JD(S) कर्नाटक से, DMK तमिलनाडु से और AIFB पश्चिम बंगाल से संबंधित है।

questions.text:

क्र. सं. | देश | विश्व में मानव विकास सूचकांक का क्रमांक
1. भारत — 130
2. म्याँमार — 148

4. पाकिस्तान — 150
निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा देश 'मानव विकास सूचकांक' में निम्न स्थान रखता है?
questions.text_english:
Study the following table related to 'World Human Development Index' and answer the question that follows:
S. No. | Country | HDI Rank in the World
1. India — 130
2. Myanmar — 148
3. Nepal — 149
4. Pakistan — 150
Which one of the following countries has the lowest rank in 'Human Development Index'?
questions.image_description: A table showing HDI ranks of four countries: India (130), Myanmar (148), Nepal (149), Pakistan (150).
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Pakistan. In the HDI ranking, a higher number indicates a lower position on the Human Development Index. India at 130 has the best position among these four countries.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) पाकिस्तान है। HDI में रैंक संख्या जितनी अधिक होगी, स्थान उतना नीचे होगा। पाकिस्तान का क्रमांक 150 सबसे अधिक है, इसलिए उसका स्थान सबसे निम्न है।

questions.text:
रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
किसी देश के अंदर किसी वर्ष विशेष में उत्पादित सभी अंतिम वस्तुओं और सेवाओं का कुल मूल्य __________ कहलाता है।
questions.text_english:
Choose the correct option to fill in the blank:
The total value of all final goods and services produced within a country in a particular year is called __________.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Gross Domestic Product (GDP). GDP is defined as the total monetary value of all final goods and services produced within the geographical boundaries of a country during a specific time period, usually one year. Per Capita Income is GDP divided by population. Gross National Income includes income earned by citizens abroad as well.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) सकल घरेलू उत्पादन (GDP) है। GDP किसी देश की भौगोलिक सीमाओं के अंदर एक वर्ष में उत्पादित सभी अंतिम वस्तुओं और सेवाओं का कुल मूल्य होता है।

questions.text:
दिए गए चित्र को देखिए और उसके नीचे दिए गए प्रश्न का उत्तर दीजिए:
चित्र में किया जाने वाला कार्य अर्थव्यवस्था के किस क्षेत्रक के अंतर्गत आता है?
questions.text_english:
Look at the given picture and answer the question that follows:
The work being done in the picture falls under which sector of the economy?
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Secondary. The picture shows workers in a manufacturing or industrial setting working with steel coils and machinery. Manufacturing industries belong to the secondary sector of the economy, which involves transforming raw materials into finished goods. Primary sector involves agriculture and mining; tertiary sector involves services; and quaternary sector involves knowledge-based activities.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) द्वितीयक है। चित्र में कारखाने में स्टील कॉयल पर काम हो रहा है जो विनिर्माण गतिविधि है। विनिर्माण उद्योग द्वितीयक क्षेत्रक के अंतर्गत आता है जिसमें कच्चे माल को तैयार वस्तुओं में बदला जाता है।

questions.text:
राखी ने अपने क्षेत्र का आर्थिक सर्वें किया है। सर्वें से पता चला कि लोग अलग-अलग कार्य करके अपनी आजीविका चलाते हैं। तालिका का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए और उसके नीचे दिए गए प्रश्न का उत्तर दीजिए:
1. अपने खेत में कार्य करने वाले कृषक — 250
2. विद्यालय में पढ़ाने वाले शिक्षक — 10
3. अपने घर में काम करने वाले बुनकर — 70
4. बड़े कारखानों में कार्य करने वाले श्रमिक — 140
5. क्षेत्र के एक अस्पताल में कार्य करने वाले कर्मचारी — 60
कुल — 530
संगठित क्षेत्रक में कितने लोग कार्यरत हैं?
questions.text_english:
Rakhi has done an economic survey of her area. The survey has revealed that people earn their livelihood by doing different jobs. Study the table carefully and answer the question that follows:
1. Farmer working in his fields — 250
2. Teachers teaching in school — 10
3. Handloom weaver working in his/her house — 70
4. Workers working in big factories — 140
5. Employees working at a hospital in the area — 60
Total — 530
How many people are working in the organised sector?
questions.image_description: A table showing work types and number of people: farmers (250), school teachers (10), handloom weavers at home (70), factory workers (140), hospital employees (60), total 530.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) 210. The organised sector includes workers who have regular employment with job security, fixed hours, and benefits under labour laws. From the table, Teachers in school (10) + Workers in big factories (140) + Hospital employees (60) = 210. Farmers working in their own fields (250) and home-based handloom weavers (70) belong to the unorganised sector as they lack formal employment protections.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) 210 है। संगठित क्षेत्रक में नियमित वेतन और सुरक्षित रोजगार वाले कर्मचारी आते हैं। विद्यालय शिक्षक (10) + कारखाने के श्रमिक (140) + अस्पताल के कर्मचारी (60) = 210।

questions.text:
भारत में ग्रामीण परिवारों के लिए ऋण की आवश्यकता पूर्ति के लिए ऋण के निम्नलिखित स्रोतों को अधिक से कम के क्रम में व्यवस्थित कीजिए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
I. सरकार
II. सहकारी बैंक और समितियाँ
III. साहूकार
IV. रिश्तेदार एवं मित्र
questions.text_english:
Arrange the following sources of credit in the most to least order to meet the credit requirement of rural households in India and choose the correct option:
I. Government
II. Cooperative Banks and Societies
III. Moneylenders
IV. Relatives and friends
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) III, II, IV, I. According to NCERT data, in rural India, moneylenders (III) are the largest source of credit for rural households, followed by cooperative banks and societies (II), then relatives and friends (IV), and the government (I) contributes the least directly. This reflects the ground reality that despite high interest rates, informal sources dominate rural credit access.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) III, II, IV, I है। भारत में ग्रामीण परिवारों के ऋण के स्रोतों में साहूकार (III) सबसे अधिक, फिर सहकारी बैंक (II), रिश्तेदार/मित्र (IV) और सरकार (I) सबसे कम।
questions.topic: Sources of Rural Credit in India

questions.text:
नीचे दो कथन I एवं II दिए गए हैं। दोनों कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
कथन I: सूचना एवं संचार प्रौद्योगिकी ने वैश्वीकरण की प्रक्रिया को उत्प्रेरित किया।
कथन II: इसका उपयोग एक-दूसरे से संपर्क करने, सूचनाओं को तत्काल प्राप्त करने और दूरवर्ती क्षेत्रों से संवाद करने में किया जाता है।
questions.text_english:
Two statements I and II are given below. Read both the statements carefully and choose the correct option:
Statement I: Information and communication technology stimulate the process of globalisation.
Statement II: It is used to contact each other, receive information instantly and communicate with remote areas.

options.A: कथन I और II दोनों सही हैं और कथन II, कथन I की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: कथन I और II दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु कथन II, कथन I की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
options.C: कथन I सही है, परन्तु कथन II गलत है।
options.D: कथन I गलत है, परन्तु कथन II सही है।

options_english.A: Both statements I and II are correct and statement II is the correct explanation of statement I.
options_english.B: Both statements I and II are correct, but statement II is not the correct explanation of statement I.
options_english.C: Statement I is correct, but statement II is incorrect.
options_english.D: Statement I is incorrect, but statement II is correct.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Both statements I and II are correct and statement II is the correct explanation of statement I. ICT has indeed stimulated globalisation (Statement I is true). Statement II correctly explains how ICT does this — by enabling instant communication, connecting people across distances, and allowing rapid exchange of information. Statement II thus directly explains why ICT stimulates globalisation, making it a valid explanation for Statement I.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। कथन I सही है — ICT ने वैश्वीकरण को तीव्र किया है। कथन II भी सही है और यह कथन I की सही व्याख्या है क्योंकि तत्काल संपर्क और दूरवर्ती क्षेत्रों से संवाद ने ही वैश्वीकरण को गति दी है।

questions.text_english:
(a) How did reinterpretation of history become a means of creating a sense of nationalism by the end of the 19th century in India? Explain.
OR
(b) How did symbols and icons contribute to create a feeling of nationalism among the people in the national movement of India? Explain.

key_points: Indian writers glorified India's ancient past to counter colonial humiliation
Historical figures like Shivaji, Rana Pratap were revived as nationalist heroes
This created pride in Indian heritage and fuelled nationalist sentiments

questions.solution:
(a) By the end of the 19th century, Indian intellectuals began reinterpreting history to instil national pride. Writers and scholars glorified India's rich ancient past in art, literature, and philosophy to counter the colonial claim that India had no civilisation worth preserving. Historical heroes like Shivaji, Rana Pratap, and figures from the Vedic age were revived as symbols of national pride and resistance, inspiring people to struggle for independence.

(b) Symbols and icons played a vital role in uniting Indians during the national movement. The image of Bharat Mata painted by Abanindranath Tagore symbolised the nation as a mother goddess. The tricolour flag became a symbol of national identity. The spinning wheel (charkha) represented self-reliance and resistance to British economic exploitation. These visual symbols gave the freedom movement a shared emotional identity, inspiring people across communities to rally together.
questions.solution_hindi: (क) 19वीं सदी के अंत तक भारतीय लेखकों और विद्वानों ने भारत के प्राचीन गौरव को उजागर किया। शिवाजी, राणा प्रताप जैसे नायकों को राष्ट्रीय प्रतीकों के रूप में प्रस्तुत किया गया जिससे लोगों में राष्ट्रप्रेम की भावना जागी।
questions.topic: Reinterpretation of History / Symbols of Nationalism

questions.text: संसाधनों के विवेकपूर्ण उपयोग के लिए नियोजन क्यों आवश्यक है? व्याख्या कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Why is planning necessary for judicious use of resources? Explain.

key_points: Resources are limited and unevenly distributed
Planning ensures equitable distribution and prevents over-exploitation
It helps achieve sustainable development for future generations

questions.solution: Planning is essential for the judicious use of resources because resources are finite and unevenly distributed across regions. Without proper planning, some regions may over-exploit resources while others remain deprived. Planning ensures equitable distribution, prevents wastage, and balances present needs with the requirements of future generations. It also helps in maintaining ecological balance and achieving sustainable development by using resources wisely and responsibly.
questions.solution_hindi: संसाधन सीमित और असमान रूप से वितरित हैं। बिना नियोजन के कुछ क्षेत्रों में अत्यधिक दोहन होगा और पर्यावरण असंतुलन बढ़ेगा। नियोजन से संसाधनों का न्यायसंगत वितरण, भविष्य की पीढ़ियों के लिए संरक्षण और सतत विकास सुनिश्चित होता है।

questions.text: भारत में 'धर्मनिरपेक्ष शासन' के मॉडल को स्थापित करने के लिए संविधान में किए गए किन्हीं दो प्रावधानों का वर्णन कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Describe any two provisions made in the Constitution to establish the model of 'secular governance' in India.

key_points: No official state religion — India does not have a state religion
Freedom of religion guaranteed to all citizens under Fundamental Rights

questions.solution: The Indian Constitution establishes secular governance through two key provisions. First, India has no official state religion — the government does not favour or discriminate against any religion, treating all religions equally. Second, the Constitution guarantees the Fundamental Right to Freedom of Religion (Articles 25–28), allowing every citizen the freedom to practice, profess, and propagate any religion of their choice. These provisions ensure the state remains neutral in religious matters.
questions.solution_hindi: भारतीय संविधान ने धर्मनिरपेक्ष शासन के लिए दो प्रमुख प्रावधान किए हैं। प्रथम, भारत का कोई राजकीय धर्म नहीं है। द्वितीय, संविधान के अनुच्छेद 25-28 के तहत प्रत्येक नागरिक को धर्म की स्वतंत्रता का मौलिक अधिकार दिया गया है।

questions.text: "देशों के बीच परस्पर संबंध और तीव्र एकीकरण की प्रक्रिया ही वैश्वीकरण है।" उदाहरणों सहित इस कथन की व्याख्या कीजिए।
questions.text_english: "Globalisation is the process of rapid integration and interconnection between countries." Explain the statement with examples.

key_points: Globalisation means integration of economies through trade, investment and technology
Example: MNCs operating across borders, free flow of goods and capital
ICT has accelerated interconnection between countries

questions.solution: Globalisation refers to the rapid integration and interconnection of countries through the free flow of goods, services, capital, technology, and people. For example, a mobile phone sold in India may have components manufactured in China, assembled in South Korea, and designed in the USA — illustrating how economies are deeply linked. ICT has accelerated this process by enabling instant communication. Multinational companies operating across borders further deepen economic and cultural interconnections between nations.
questions.solution_hindi: वैश्वीकरण का अर्थ है देशों के बीच वस्तुओं, पूंजी, प्रौद्योगिकी और लोगों का मुक्त प्रवाह। उदाहरण के लिए, भारत में बिकने वाले मोबाइल के पुर्जे चीन में बने, कोरिया में जोड़े गए और अमेरिका में डिजाइन हुए — यह आर्थिक एकीकरण का उदाहरण है।

questions.text: महात्मा गाँधी ने असहयोग आंदोलन वापस लेने का फैसला क्यों किया? किन्हीं तीन कारणों का विश्लेषण कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Why did Mahatma Gandhi decide to withdraw the Non-Cooperation Movement? Analyse any three reasons.

key_points: Chauri Chaura incident (February 1922) — violent mob attack on police
Gandhi believed the movement had turned violent, against his principle of non-violence
He feared mass movements could go out of control without proper discipline

questions.solution: Mahatma Gandhi withdrew the Non-Cooperation Movement in February 1922 for three key reasons. First, the Chauri Chaura incident occurred in Gorakhpur where an angry mob attacked and set fire to a police station, killing about 22 policemen — this direct act of violence deeply disturbed Gandhi. Second, Gandhi firmly believed in non-violence as the foundational principle of the movement, and any violence would destroy its moral authority. Third, he felt that the Indian masses were not yet fully prepared for a disciplined, non-violent mass movement and required more constructive training before continuing.
questions.solution_hindi: महात्मा गाँधी ने फरवरी 1922 में असहयोग आंदोलन तीन मुख्य कारणों से वापस लिया। प्रथम, गोरखपुर के चौरी-चौरा में भीड़ ने पुलिस थाने में आग लगा दी जिसमें लगभग 22 पुलिसकर्मी मारे गए। द्वितीय, गाँधीजी अहिंसा के कट्टर समर्थक थे और हिंसा ने आंदोलन की नैतिक शक्ति को कमजोर किया। तृतीय, उन्हें लगा कि जनता अभी अनुशासित अहिंसक आंदोलन के लिए पूरी तरह तैयार नहीं है।

questions.text:
रिंझा की कहानी को पढ़िए और उसके नीचे दिए गए प्रश्न का उत्तर दीजिए:
रिंझा असम में डिफु के बाहरी क्षेत्र में अपने परिवार के साथ एक गाँव में रहती है। वह अपने परिवार के सदस्यों द्वारा एक भूमि के टुकड़े पर उगी वनस्पति को काटकर व जलाकर साफ करते देखकर आनंद का अनुभव करती है। वह प्राय: परिवार के सदस्यों के साथ बाँस के नाले द्वारा झरने से पानी लाकर अपने खेत को सिंचित करने में सहायता करती है। वह अपने परिवेश से लगाव रखती है और जब तक संभव हो यहाँ रहना चाहती है, परन्तु इस छोटी बच्ची को अपने खेत में मिट्टी की घटती उर्वरता के बारे में कुछ भी पता नहीं है जिसके कारण उसके परिवार को अगले वर्ष नए भूमि के टुकड़े की तलाश करनी होगी।
रिंझा को कोई तीन उपाय सुझाइए, जिससे उसके खेत की मिट्टी की उर्वरता लंबे समय तक बनी रहे।
questions.text_english:
Read the story of Rinjha and answer the question that follows:
Rinjha lived with her family in a small village at the outskirts of Diphu in Assam. She enjoys watching her family members clearing, slashing and burning a patch of land for cultivation. She often helps them in irrigating the fields with water running through a bamboo canal from the nearby spring. She loves the surroundings and wants to stay here as long as she can, but this little girl has no idea about the declining fertility of the soil and her family's search for a fresh patch of land in the next season.
Suggest any three measures to Rinjha so that the fertility of the soil of her fields remains intact for a long time.

key_points: Stop slash-and-burn (Jhumming) and adopt settled farming with crop rotation
Use organic manure and compost instead of burning crop residue
Practise mixed farming and plant cover crops to protect soil

questions.solution: Rinjha can adopt the following three measures to maintain soil fertility for a long time. First, she should stop the practice of slash-and-burn (Jhum cultivation) as burning destroys soil microbes and reduces fertility; instead, she should practise settled agriculture with crop rotation to restore nutrients. Second, she should use organic manure, compost, and green manure instead of chemical fertilisers to sustainably improve soil health. Third, she should plant nitrogen-fixing cover crops like legumes between seasons to naturally enrich the soil and prevent erosion.

This deprived Tamil-speaking citizens of access to government jobs and education. Furthermore, university admissions and state employment were biased in favour of the Sinhalese majority. OR
(b) Describe three major challenges faced by the political parties in India.

key_points: (a) Contest elections, form government, make policies
(b) Internal democracy lacking, dynasty politics, money and criminal elements

questions.solution:
(a) Political parties perform three main functions in a democracy. First, they contest elections — parties put up candidates, campaign, and seek public votes to win power. Second, they form the government and make policies — the winning party (or coalition) forms the government and shapes legislation and national policies. Third, they play the role of opposition — parties that lose elections sit in the legislature to scrutinise the government, expose failures, and present alternative policies.

(b) Indian political parties face three major challenges. First, lack of internal democracy — power is concentrated in the hands of a few leaders and ordinary party members have little say, undermining democratic functioning. Second, dynastic succession — many parties pass leadership within one family, denying opportunities to other capable members. Third, the use of money and muscle power — parties and candidates increasingly rely on wealthy donors and criminal elements to win elections, corrupting the democratic process.

key_points: Underemployment means people appear employed but are not productively utilised
Agriculture is seasonal — workers remain idle for several months

questions.solution: Underemployment in Indian agriculture refers to a situation where people are nominally employed but are not productively utilised to their full potential. It takes two main forms. First, seasonal unemployment — agricultural work is available only during sowing and harvesting seasons, leaving farm workers idle for several months each year. Second, disguised unemployment — more people work on a farm than are actually required; if some workers are removed, total output would not decrease. This surplus labour in agriculture lowers productivity, reduces income, and hinders overall economic development.

questions.text_english:
(a) How did the French Revolution spread the spirit of nationalism in Europe? Explain with suitable arguments.
OR
(b) How did the Greek freedom struggle arouse nationalist sentiments in Europe? Explain with suitable arguments.

key_points: French Revolution introduced ideas of liberty, equality, fraternity
Napoleon spread revolutionary ideas through his conquests across Europe
Abolished feudalism and introduced uniform laws in conquered territories
Inspired other European peoples to fight against their own autocratic rulers
Created sense of collective national identity among Europeans

questions.solution:
(a) The French Revolution of 1789 played a pivotal role in spreading nationalism across Europe. The Revolution introduced the revolutionary ideas of liberty, equality, and fraternity, which inspired people across Europe to challenge their feudal rulers. Napoleon Bonaparte's conquests carried these ideas into territories across Europe — he abolished feudal privileges, introduced the Civil Code (Napoleonic Code) which established equality before law, and dismantled old aristocratic institutions. The Continental System and the creation of new states helped spread the principles of national sovereignty. Though Napoleon later became an imperialist, his initial reforms awakened national consciousness and inspired local populations to demand self-governance, sowing the seeds of nationalist movements across Germany, Italy, and other European nations.

(b) The Greek war of independence (1821–1829) significantly aroused nationalist sentiments across Europe. Greece had been under Ottoman rule for centuries. The struggle for Greek independence drew enormous sympathy from European liberals and romantics who saw Greece as the cradle of European civilisation. European intellectuals, poets like Lord Byron, and artists championed the Greek cause. The Treaty of Constantinople in 1832 recognised Greece as an independent nation. This success demonstrated that people could fight for and win national self-determination, inspiring nationalist movements in other parts of Europe, particularly among oppressed peoples in Italy, Germany, and Eastern Europe who began to aspire for their own unified, independent nations.

questions.solution:
(a) Industries are a major cause of increasing air pollution. Factories release large quantities of smoke, dust, fumes, and toxic gases such as sulphur dioxide, carbon monoxide, and nitrogen oxides into the atmosphere. Thermal power plants that burn coal contribute enormous amounts of CO₂ and ash particles. Chemical, cement, and paper industries also release harmful particulate matter. To control industrial air pollution, the following measures should be adopted: installation of smokestacks with filters and electrostatic precipitators to trap particles; mandatory use of cleaner fuels like CNG in industrial operations; shifting to renewable energy sources such as solar and wind power; strict enforcement of pollution control laws and penalties for violators; and regular environmental impact assessments of industries.

(b) NTPC has taken several important measures to prevent environmental degradation. It has established ash ponds to prevent fly-ash from polluting land and water. It develops green belts around its power plants to reduce dust and noise. NTPC promotes energy conservation by adopting efficient technologies and reducing fuel consumption. It recycles waste water from power plants to reduce freshwater use. It has also introduced ash utilisation programmes where fly-ash is used in brick-making and cement industry, converting waste into a useful resource. These steps reflect NTPC's commitment to balancing energy production with environmental responsibility.

questions.text_english:
(a) How is democracy better than other types of government? Analyse.
OR
(b) Analyse the role of democracy in reducing inequality and poverty.

key_points: Accountable and legitimate government through elections
Protects rights and freedoms of citizens
Allows peaceful transfer of power
Promotes political equality — one person one vote
Enables citizens to participate in decision-making

questions.solution:
(a) Democracy is superior to other forms of government for several compelling reasons. First, it provides an accountable and legitimate government — leaders are chosen by the people through regular elections and can be removed if they fail to perform. Second, democracy protects the fundamental rights and freedoms of citizens, including freedom of speech, religion, and equality before law. Third, it ensures peaceful transfer of power, avoiding the violence and instability common in authoritarian regimes. Fourth, democracy promotes political equality through the principle of one person, one vote, regardless of wealth or status. Finally, it encourages participation of citizens in governance and decision-making, making rulers responsive to public needs and creating a government that is of the people, by the people, and for the people.

(b) Democracy plays an important role in reducing inequality and poverty. In a democracy, the voice of the poor and marginalised can be heard through elections and public pressure. Governments are accountable to the electorate, so they are compelled to implement welfare schemes targeting poverty reduction. Democratic governments have introduced policies like MNREGA, which guarantees employment to rural poor. Reservation policies protect historically disadvantaged communities. Freedom of press and active civil society expose corruption and demand better resource distribution. However, in practice, economic inequality often persists because wealthy groups exert undue influence over democratic processes, showing that democracy alone is insufficient without strong institutional safeguards.

questions.text_english:
(a) How is income an important factor in assessing the development of a country? Mention the classification done by the World Bank. (2+3=5)
OR
(b) How has the overuse of underground water created a serious crisis in many parts of India? Explain with examples in the context of sustainable development. (2+3=5)

key_points: Income indicates standard of living and access to goods/services
World Bank classifies: Low income, Lower-middle, Upper-middle, High income based on GNI per capita
Limitations: income alone doesn't capture health, education, social equality

questions.solution:
(a) Income is a crucial factor in assessing a country's development because it determines citizens' ability to meet basic needs, access education, healthcare, and maintain a standard of living. A higher national income generally means more resources for public welfare. The World Bank classifies countries based on Gross National Income (GNI) per capita: countries with annual GNI per capita of USD 1,085 or less are classified as Low Income countries; USD 1,086–4,255 as Lower-Middle Income; USD 4,256–13,205 as Upper-Middle Income; and above USD 13,205 as High Income countries. India is classified as a Lower-Middle Income country. However, income alone has limitations — it doesn't capture inequality, quality of life, education levels, or environmental health, which is why other indicators like HDI are also used.

(b) The overuse of underground water in India has created a severe crisis threatening sustainable development. In Punjab and Haryana, the Green Revolution led to intensive cultivation of water-intensive crops like paddy and wheat, causing groundwater levels to fall dramatically. In Rajasthan, urbanisation and agriculture have depleted ancient water sources. As water tables decline, farmers need deeper and more expensive borewells, increasing costs and reducing agricultural viability. In coastal areas like Gujarat, over-extraction causes saltwater intrusion, rendering groundwater unusable. This threatens the sustainability of agriculture and drinking water supplies. Sustainable development demands that we use groundwater at a rate that allows natural replenishment — through rainwater harvesting, regulated extraction, and shifting to less water-intensive crops.

Print Culture and the French Revolution

Many historians have argued that print culture created the conditions within which French Revolution occurred.

Some arguments have been usually put forward in this context.

First: print popularised the ideas of the Enlightenment thinkers. Collectively, their writings provided a critical commentary on tradition, superstition and despotism. They argued for the rule of reason rather than custom, and demanded that everything be judged through the application of reason and rationality. They attacked the sacred authority of the Church and the despotic power of the state, thus eroding the legitimacy of a social order based on tradition. The writings of Voltaire and Rousseau were read widely; and those who read these books saw the world through new eyes, eyes that were questioning, critical and rational.

Second: print created a new culture of dialogue and debate. All values, norms and institutions were re-evaluated and discussed by a public that had become aware of the power of reason, and recognised the need to question existing ideas and beliefs. Within this public culture, new ideas of social revolution came into being.

sub_questions.solution: Print culture contributed to social revolution in France in two significant ways. First, it popularised the ideas of Enlightenment thinkers like Voltaire and Rousseau, whose writings attacked the Church's authority, state despotism, and traditions based on superstition. This eroded the legitimacy of the old social order. Second, print created a new culture of public dialogue and debate where ordinary people began questioning established values, norms, and institutions. This new critical, rational public consciousness laid the intellectual groundwork for the social and political revolution that overthrew the monarchy and feudal system in France.

भारत में विकेंद्रीकरण

विकेंद्रीकरण की ज़रूरत हमारे संविधान में भी स्वीकार की गई। इसके बाद से गाँव और शहर के स्तर पर सत्ता के विकेंद्रीकरण की कई कोशिशें हुई हैं। सभी राज्यों में गाँव के स्तर पर ग्राम पंचायतों और शहरों में नगरपालिकाओं की स्थापना की गई थी। पर इन्हें राज्य सरकारों के सीधे नियंत्रण में रखा गया था। इन स्थानीय सरकारों के लिए नियमित ढंग से चुनाव भी नहीं कराए जाते थे। इनके पास न तो अपना कोई अधिकार था न संसाधन। इस प्रकार प्रभावी ढंग से सत्ता का विकेंद्रीकरण नाम मात्र का हुआ था।

वास्तविक विकेंद्रीकरण की दिशा में एक बड़ा कदम 1992 में उठाया गया। संविधान में संशोधन करके लोकतांत्रिक शासन व्यवस्था के इस तीसरे स्तर को ज़्यादा शक्तिशाली और प्रभावी बनाया गया।
questions.text_english:
Read the given source and answer the questions that follow:

Decentralisation in India

The need for decentralisation was recognised in our Constitution. Since then, there have been several attempts to decentralise power to the level of villages and towns. Panchayats in villages and municipalities in urban areas were set up in all the States. But these were directly under the control of state governments. Elections to these local governments were not held regularly. Local governments did not have any powers or resources of their own. Thus, there was very little decentralisation in effective terms.

A major step towards decentralisation was taken in 1992. The Constitution was amended to make the third-tier of democracy more powerful and effective.

sub_questions.text: भारतीय संविधान में सत्ता का विकेंद्रीकरण कितने स्तरों पर किया गया है?
sub_questions.text_english: At how many levels has decentralisation of power been done in the Indian Constitution?

key_points: Three levels — Central, State, and Local (Panchayati Raj / Municipal)

sub_questions.solution: In the Indian Constitution, decentralisation of power has been done at three levels — the Central Government at the national level, the State Governments at the state level, and Local Self-Governments (Panchayats in rural areas and Municipalities in urban areas) at the third tier. The 73rd and 74th Constitutional Amendments in 1992 strengthened this third tier.

sub_questions.text: समस्याओं के समाधान में स्थानीय स्व-शासन की भूमिका को स्पष्ट कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain the role of local self-government in solving problems.

key_points: Local governments understand local problems better and can address them more quickly and effectively

sub_questions.solution: Local self-government plays a crucial role in solving community problems because local elected representatives understand the specific needs and issues of their area far better than distant state or central governments. They can address issues like water supply, sanitation, roads, and schools more directly, quickly, and efficiently. Their proximity to the people ensures accountability and meaningful participation of citizens in governance.

sub_questions.text: "स्थानीय सरकारों की स्थापना स्व-शासन के लोकतांत्रिक सिद्धांत को वास्तविक बनाने का सबसे अच्छा तरीका है।" इस कथन की व्याख्या कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: "Local government is the best way to realise one important principle of democracy, namely local self-government." Explain the statement.

key_points: Local government brings democracy to grassroots level
Citizens participate directly in decisions affecting their daily lives

sub_questions.solution: Local government is the best way to realise local self-governance because it brings democracy to the grassroots level. When people elect their own Panchayat members or municipal councillors, they directly participate in decisions that affect their daily lives — such as local roads, water supply, schools, and health centres. This ensures that governance is responsive, accountable, and transparent at the community level. It empowers marginalised groups, including women and scheduled castes, through reservation policies, making democracy truly inclusive and participatory rather than limited to distant national or state-level institutions.

अरुण एक किसान मज़दूर के काम का निरीक्षण करता है। अरुण के पास 7 एकड़ ज़मीन है। अरुण सोनपुर के उन कुछ लोगों में से है, जिसे खेती के लिए बैंक से ऋण मिला है। इस ऋण पर वार्षिक ब्याज दर 8·5 प्रतिशत है और इसे अगले तीन वर्षों में कभी भी लौटाया जा सकता है। अरुण की योजना है कि वे फसल तैयार होने पर अपनी उपज का कुछ हिस्सा बेचकर इस ऋण की अदाएगी कर देगा। वह बाकी आलू की फसल को शीत भंडार गृह में रखकर बैंक से इसके बदले नया ऋण लेने के लिए आवेदन देना चाहता है। बैंक उन किसानों को ऐसी सुविधा देने के लिए तैयार है जो पहले ही खेती के लिए उससे ऋण ले चुके हैं।

Arun's Story

Arun supervises the work of one farm labourer. Arun has seven acres of land. He is one of the few persons in Sonpur to receive bank loan for cultivation. The interest rate on the loan is 8·5 per cent per annum, and can be repaid anytime in the next three years. Arun plans to repay the loan after harvest by selling a part of the crop. He then intends to store the rest of the potatoes in a cold storage and apply for a fresh loan from the bank against the cold storage receipt. The bank offers this facility to farmers who have taken crop loan from them.

sub_questions.text: अरुण का ऋण किस स्रोत के अंतर्गत आता है?
sub_questions.text_english: Under which source does Arun's loan come?

key_points: Formal source of credit — Bank loan

sub_questions.solution: Arun's loan comes under the formal source of credit, specifically a bank loan. Banks are regulated by the Reserve Bank of India and provide credit at reasonable interest rates with proper documentation. Since Arun received a loan from a bank at 8.5% per annum, it falls in the formal credit sector.

sub_questions.text: बैंक से ऋण लेने की एक प्रमुख शर्त का उल्लेख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Mention one important term of credit for taking a loan from the bank.

key_points: Collateral — borrower must provide an asset as security for the loan

sub_questions.solution: One important term of credit for taking a loan from a bank is collateral — the borrower must provide an asset (such as land, property, or goods) as security against the loan. In Arun's case, he uses the cold storage receipt for his potato stock as collateral to apply for a fresh loan, demonstrating how collateral enables access to formal credit.

sub_questions.text: अरुण का ऋण किस प्रकार लाभकारी है? किन्हीं दो कारणों की व्याख्या कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: How is Arun's loan beneficial? Explain any two reasons.

key_points: Low interest rate (8.5%) compared to moneylenders who charge very high rates
Flexible repayment — can be repaid any time within three years as per convenience

sub_questions.solution: Arun's bank loan is beneficial in two important ways. First, the interest rate is low at 8.5% per annum compared to moneylenders who typically charge 30–40% interest in rural areas, reducing Arun's financial burden significantly. Second, the repayment is flexible — he can repay the loan anytime within three years, allowing him to sell his crops at an advantageous time rather than being forced to sell immediately at low prices. This financial security helps him plan his farming activities more effectively and improve his income.
